prompt: clang-cl /Zp no value struct packing behavior
answer:
In `clang-cl`, `/Zp` with no value is equivalent to `/Zp1`: it sets the default maximum struct-packing alignment to **1 byte**.

It is translated internally to:

```text
-fpack-struct=1
```

Thus, structure members are packed with a maximum alignment of one byte. `clang-cl` also supports `/Zp<value>` for specifying another maximum alignment, such as `/Zp2`, `/Zp4`, `/Zp8`, or `/Zp16`. ([Clang User’s Manual](https://releases.llvm.org/18.1.0/tools/clang/docs/UsersManual.html); [LLVM commit](https://staging-git.codelinaro.org/clo/la-archived-restored-vipin/toolchain/clang/-/commit/cee97e00d71f19d17a0ea416ed7d72780da05bd8))
